bio: Convivial and informal with a touch of elegance, this restaurant is perfect for a night out with friends – and indeed for anyone in the mood for delicious cuisine brimming with flavours which are predominantly Roman in style. The carbonara and amatriciana are superb, while the antipasti (especially the croquettes and artichoke in season) should not be missed. An impressive selection of cocktails completes the picture. Booking is recommended, as it’s often full!...
